response.sql: WITH feature_shares AS (SELECT zoneref, traitcount, traitcount * 1.0 / SUM(traitcount) OVER () AS share FROM scanfeatures WHERE traitcount IS NOT NULL), compared AS (SELECT zoneref, traitcount, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM feature_shares) SELECT zoneref AS site_code, traitcount AS feature_count, share, share - average_share AS margin_above_average FROM compared WHERE share > average_share ORDER BY margin_above_average DESC LIMIT 10;
